title: RF4CE: Fix illegal memory accesses
description:
Catch the possibility of a packet to have an address type that is not AT_EUI64 nor the custom type used by IEEE 802.15.4 dissector for short address - use hints from IEEE 802.15.4 to get the short address, when hints are available, avoiding illegal memory accesses

Fix #19434
